title: Acetylcholinesterase Accelerates Assembly of Amyloid-β-Peptides into Alzheimer's Fibrils: Possible Role of the Peripheral Site of the Enzyme
why_used_in_v2: AChE can enhance Aβ fibrillogenesis; propidium attenuated the effect whereas the active-site inhibitor edrophonium did not. This is the central directionality control.

title: A structural motif of acetylcholinesterase that promotes amyloid beta-peptide fibril formation
why_used_in_v2: A hydrophobic AChE motif near PAS can influence Aβ fibrillation; it does not establish that arbitrary short PAS-binding peptides promote aggregation.

title: Stable complexes involving acetylcholinesterase and amyloid-beta peptide change the biochemical properties of the enzyme and increase the neurotoxicity of Alzheimer's fibrils
why_used_in_v2: Supports treating AChE–Aβ aggregate toxicity as a distinct experimental condition from Aβ alone.

title: Neurotoxicity of acetylcholinesterase amyloid beta-peptide aggregates is dependent on the type of Aβ peptide and the AChE concentration present in the complexes
why_used_in_v2: Supports separate Aβ, AChE–Aβ, and AChE–Aβ–peptide conditions in PC12 assays.

title: Crystal Structure of Recombinant Human Acetylcholinesterase in Complex with (-)-galantamine (PDB 4EY6)
why_used_in_v2: Confirms that 4EY6 is a human AChE galantamine co-crystal; ligand/heteroatom handling must be disclosed.

title: A large language model for predicting neurotoxic peptides and neurotoxins
why_used_in_v2: NTxPred2 classifies generic neurotoxic peptide labels; it is not a PC12 viability, Aβ-coexposure, or dose-response model.

title: Massive experimental quantification allows interpretable deep learning of protein aggregation
why_used_in_v2: CANYA was trained from random 20-aa sequences in a Sup35N-fusion selection; short 7–9-aa free peptides are a material domain shift.

title: AggBERT: Best in Class Prediction of Hexapeptide Amyloidogenesis with a Semi-Supervised ProtBERT Model
why_used_in_v2: A hexapeptide intrinsic-amyloidogenicity model; at most a sliding-window self-aggregation annotation for this project.

title: Machine Learning–Based Bioactivity Prediction and Descriptor-Guided Rational Design of Amyloid-β Aggregation Inhibitors
why_used_in_v2: Small-molecule Aβ inhibitor/IC50 model; wrong molecule class and opposite biological direction for the present peptides.

title: Inhibition of PC12 cell redox activity is a specific, early indicator of the mechanism of beta-amyloid-mediated cell death
why_used_in_v2: MTT/CCK-8-type redox viability readouts are useful but insufficient alone to claim irreversible cell death.
